title: Compute the shared source_id from Git commit ids plus one hash of the Git diff, in the one existing producer
outcome: Compute the shared source_id from Git commit ids plus one hash of the Git diff, in the one existing producer
acceptance: The one existing source_id producer records the root and submodule commit ids plus exactly one hash over defined Git delta bytes, instead of a per-changed-file list with a hash per file; it does no environment inventory, whole-repository or submodule file census, per-file hash-object, or second capture within one producer call

The contract states exactly which delta the hash covers: index versus HEAD, worktree versus index, untracked non-ignored files (which plain git diff omits) and submodule state; ignored paths stay excluded; unavailable or partial capture never becomes a complete identity; the previously recorded visibility guarantees are kept, not assumed dropped

Engram's own consumers (committed-input, launcher before/after comparison, evaluation and completion) use the new shape; records already stored keep being read as stored and are never recomputed; no parallel second identity is introduced

TermAl's consumers switch in coordination with Termal::Fable2 at an agreed point, and a behaviour test shows an unchanged tree gives an equal source_id before and after, while a changed tracked, staged or untracked file changes it
